_comment: Block registry. Order sets the numeric id (air is 0); saves store names, so ids may change between builds. tex: one texture name, or {top, side, bottom}. render: cube | cross | liquid | none. layer: opaque | cutout | translucent. filter: extra light lost passing through (leaves, water). hardness: seconds to mine with the builder's steel tools. boxes (render model): boxes in sixteenths [x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1], drawn facing north. boxTex: a texture for each box in the same order (null: the block's own), so one block can be wood and cloth; a texture named lit_… glows by itself and one named flame_… also wavers (docs/HOME.md).
